shared-fp32-reproducer.content:
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from rl_engine.backends.shared.triton.gemm.det_gemm import _triton_gemm_fp32

torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32=False
root=Path.cwd()
g=torch.Generator(device='cuda').manual_seed(420)
checks=[]
for m,k,n in [(1,65,73),(33,129,67),(129,5376,73)]:
    a=torch.randn((m,k),generator=g,device='cuda').bfloat16()
    b=torch.randn((k,n),generator=g,device='cuda').bfloat16()
    actual=_triton_gemm_fp32(a,b)
    reference=a.float()@b.float()
    error=(actual-reference).abs()
    limit=1e-4+1e-4*reference.abs()
    repeat=_triton_gemm_fp32(a,b)
    reversed_result=_triton_gemm_fp32(a.flip(0),b).flip(0)
    checks.append({'shape':[m,k,n],'dtype':'bfloat16','output_dtype':'float32','seed':420,'atol':1e-4,'rtol':1e-4,'max_abs_error':error.max().item(),'max_error_over_tolerance':(error/limit).max().item(),'accuracy_passed':bool((error<=limit).all()),'repeat_passed':torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8),repeat.view(torch.uint8)),'permutation_passed':torch.equal(actual.view(torch.uint8),reversed_result.view(torch.uint8))})
report={'source_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'rl_engine/backends/shared/triton/gemm/det_gemm.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'backend':'_triton_gemm_fp32; default INDEX_64=False, PROMOTE_INPUTS=True','torch':torch.__version__,'gpu':torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),'architecture':list(torch.cuda.get_device_capability()),'checks':checks,'status':'passed' if all(c['accuracy_passed'] and c['repeat_passed'] and c['permutation_passed'] for c in checks) else 'failed'}
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if report['status']=='passed' else 1)
